vo_open.text: It went five years without eating.

vo.text: Giant isopods have survived more than five years without food, in captivity.
This is real footage, filmed by a robot eight hundred sixteen meters down.
They live as deep as two thousand one hundred forty meters, and eat dead whales, fish and squid.
The largest confirmed was about fifty centimeters long.
Each eye has nearly four thousand facets. And their relatives? The tiny woodlice in your garden.
Would you eat one? Yes or no? Comment, subscribe, and watch seven more deep-sea creatures, linked below.
